name: El Futuro
evidence: Site posts no fees; appointments page only says "If you have Medicaid, or Medicare, bring your most recent insurance card" and "We also serve individuals without insurance."

name: World Relief Durham – Immigration Legal Services
evidence: "The cost of the consultation is $50 and must be paid by money order, credit card, or debit card." Directory also answers "Nominal fee charged?" Yes.
cost_note: Consultation costs $50 (money order or card; no cash or checks). Case fees are nominal; ask when you book.

name: Planned Parenthood – Chapel Hill Health Center
evidence: Clinic page blocked (403). PPSAT says only that at "many locations" patients "may be eligible for low to no-cost birth control"; no Chapel Hill fee or sliding-scale details found.

name: Durham County Public Health – STI/HIV, Family Planning, Vaccine & TB Clinics
evidence: "STI and HIV testing are provided free of charge." "The DCoDPH provides certain STI medications free of charge. Other medications may be available at a reduced rate based on your income."
cost_note: STI/HIV testing is free; some STI medicines are free, others cost less by income. Other services, like TB tests and vasectomy, have fees.

name: Wake County Departure Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
evidence: County says HIV/STI tests are free ("All tests are free and confidential") and offers no-cost home test kits; regional center clinic pages say "Charges for services are based on income."
cost_note: STI testing and at-home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines are charged based on income.

name: Wake County Northern Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
evidence: County says HIV/STI tests are free ("All tests are free and confidential") and offers no-cost home test kits; regional center clinic pages say "Charges for services are based on income."
cost_note: STI testing and at-home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines are charged based on income.

name: Wake Smiles
evidence: "There is a $40 administrative fee for each appointment."
cost_note: Dental care costs a $40 administrative fee per appointment.

name: SPCA Wake – Saving Lives Spay/Neuter Clinic
evidence: "The Saving Lives Spay/Neuter Clinic is a low-cost clinic." Cats $60-120; dogs up to 59 lbs $200-230, 60-99 lbs $240-270.
cost_note: Cats $60-120; dogs $200-270 depending on size and sex. Rabies and distemper vaccines and pain medicine included.

name: SAFE Care Spay/Neuter Clinic (cats)
evidence: Pricing page: "Female Cats – $100", "Male Cats – $90", "Feral / Community Cats – $60"; fee includes exam, rabies and distemper vaccines, pain injections.
cost_note: Female cat $100, male cat $90, community cat $60, including exam, rabies and distemper vaccines and pain shots.

name: Five County Spay Neuter Clinic
evidence: Clinic aims to "Offer a low-cost option for spays / neuters". Fees: dogs "Up to 59 lbs: $215" to "$330 and up"; cats "Any weight: $105".
cost_note: Cats $105; dogs $215-330+ by weight. Extra fee if pet is in heat or pregnant.

name: Durham County Sheriff's Office Animal Services – $10 Rabies Vaccinations
evidence: "Vaccinations are by appointment only and cost $10 per pet." (county notice, Aug 2025)
cost_note: Rabies shots are $10 per pet, by appointment.

name: Orange County Animal Services – Rabies & Microchip Clinic (Hillsborough)
evidence: "Clinics will typically offer 1-year and 3-year vaccinations for $10." "Microchips will also be offered at these clinics for $35 each."
cost_note: Rabies vaccine $10; microchip $35.

name: Briggs Avenue Community Garden
evidence: Extension page mentions "free hands-on agriculture education" but no plot fee; no current Briggs Avenue plot fee found.

name: GoTriangle regional buses – free & discount GoPass (seniors, youth, disability)
evidence: Full fare $2.50, discount $1.25; Youth (13-18), Seniors (65+) and Transit Assistance Pass holders "Qualify for Free Fare".
cost_note: Free with a GoPass for seniors 65+, youth 13-18 and Transit Assistance Pass holders; others pay $2.50 ($1.25 discount fare).

name: GoCary Door to Door (paratransit & senior rides, incl. Apex)
evidence: Tier 1: "Cost: $2.50 Currently Free"; Tier 2 within Cary $4; Tier 3 medical trips: Apex/Morrisville $6, Raleigh $7, Durham $8, Chapel Hill $9. "PCAs ride for free."
cost_note: Trips near bus routes are free for now; other Cary trips $4; medical trips to other towns $6-9.

name: GoTriangle Access (regional ADA paratransit)
evidence: Trips are "at a cost of $5.00 per trip"; 10 Punch Pass $50, Monthly Pass $160; "Children 12 and under ride free."
cost_note: $5 per one-way trip; 10-ride pass $50; monthly pass $160. Children 12 and under ride free.

name: GoRaleigh MicroLink – Rolesville (on-demand rides)
evidence: GoRaleigh FAQ still says "MicroLink is a fare-free service through June 30, 2025"; no current fare found.

name: Durham County ACCESS (rides for seniors, people with disabilities, rural residents)
evidence: "GoDurham ACCESS and Durham County ACCESS are free to ride until June 30, 2027."

name: Orange County Public Transportation – Demand Response (rural, senior, disability & work rides)
evidence: EDTAP: "FARE COST: $3.00 One-Way"; Rural General Public: "$3.00 One-Way"; Employment and Transportation Assistance Program: "FARE COST: $0".
cost_note: Work and job-training rides are free; senior, disability and rural rides are $3 each way.

name: Orange County Department on Aging – Volunteer Driver Program
evidence: County transportation page and older-adult transportation guide describe the Volunteer Driver Program but state no cost to riders.

name: Chatham Transit Network (rides anywhere in Chatham County)
evidence: In-County fares by distance: "fares from $2.00" up to $13 (25.1-27 mi); "Fares must be paid upon boarding."
cost_note: Fares by distance, $2 to $13 each way; children under 13 with a parent and one aide ride free.

name: Duke Memorial UMC  Good Samaritan Fund
evidence: Fund provides "discretionary spending aimed at granting financial assistance for utilities and food"; no fee to recipients. Utility applications currently closed, "will open again December 1."

name: Senior PharmAssist
evidence: No fees posted on site. Program materials: medication therapy management "free of charge if income <300% FPL"; Medicare counseling offered "at no charge"; copay help via secondary pharmacy card.

name: Families Moving Forward
evidence: Durham County housing guide (updated Nov 2026) lists Families Moving Forward emergency shelter cost as "No cost".

name: AIDS Community Residence Association, Inc.
evidence: "Rent is based on 30% of gross adjusted income."
cost_note: Rent is 30% of adjusted gross income.

name: Just A Clean House, Inc.
evidence: Durham County housing guide (Nov 2026): "$146-171 per week; Varies by location; Based on if it is a single or shared room".
cost_note: Rent is about $146-171 per week, depending on the house and single or shared room.

name: Durham Housing Authority (DHA)
evidence: Public housing: "Rent is based on 30% of an individual's income, which includes utilities." "Rent is set to be no more than affordable percentage (usually 30%) of your income."
cost_note: Rent is usually set at about 30% of household income.

name: TROSA
evidence: "Cost-free residential treatment for substance use disorders"; TROSA provides "free housing, meals, clothing, vocational and life skills training."

name: Welcome Baby Durham County Cooperative Extension
evidence: The Giving Closet is "a free family resource."

name: El Pueblo- Familias Seguras
evidence: PDF cover: "Guía de emergencia para inmigrantes – Gratuita" (free Spanish-language family emergency planning guide).

name: U.S. Committee for Refugees and Immigrants, Raleigh
evidence: USCRI offers "low- to no-cost professional legal representation"; Raleigh office directory listing: "Nominal fee charged?" Yes. No consultation fee amount found.
cost_note: Nominal fees apply; ask about the consultation fee when you contact the hotline.

name: Council on Immigrant Relations (CIR)
evidence: Site describes "low Cost immigration services"; directory: "Nominal fee charged?" Yes, and "low-cost legal defense." Amount not posted.
cost_note: Low-cost legal help with a nominal consultation fee; payment plans available for representation.

name: Centro para familias Hispanas
evidence: CPFH "offers tax preparation services free of charge"; Catholic Charities Raleigh (same address, 2013 Raleigh Blvd) immigration listing: "Consultation fees $50".
cost_note: Tax preparation is free; immigration legal consultations cost $50.

name: Immigrant Solidarity Fund - CWS Durham
evidence: "Eligible applicants can receive a one-time cash assistance grant"; waitlist active, "average wait times for support from the ISF are currently several months."

name: JusticeMatters Inc
evidence: Own site posts no fees. Christian Legal Society clinic listing: provides legal services "on a sliding scale basis to Durham, Wake, and Orange residents who meet its case acceptance criteria."

name: WakeTech Community College (ESL)
evidence: Wake Tech ESL course listing: "classes are free for students with no English to students with high-level English skills." (EFL and Beyond the Basics carry fees.)

name: First Presbyterian Church
evidence: Friendship Fund offers "emergency assistance with rent, mortgages, and household utilities"; payments go to vendors; "The ministry is funded entirely by donations."

name: St Thomas Moore Church
evidence: Parish ministry gives utility help to residents with a disconnect notice once every 12 months; page states it does not provide rental assistance. No fee to recipients.

name: El Centro Hispano – Durham
evidence: Website and services checklist list programs (legal info, ESL, financial assistance) but give no fees; an older Durham VOICE article said services are free but ESL classes cost $20.

name: Durham Literacy Center
evidence: ESOL program page: "provides free English classes for adult learners." No fees mentioned for tutoring or classes.

name: Planned Parenthood – Raleigh Health Center
evidence: Site blocks fetch; PPSAT says insurance accepted, co-pays due at visit; Raleigh offers a 25% teen discount but isn't listed for the Title X sliding-scale program.

name: Wake County Public Health Center – STI/HIV, Family Planning, Vaccine & TB Clinics
evidence: "STI services are provided at no charge to you except for HPV ... treatment." Family planning: "discounts may be available based on income and family size."
cost_note: STI/HIV testing and treatment and home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines have fees with income-based discounts.

name: Wake County Eastern Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
evidence: County STI services "are provided at no charge ... except for HPV treatment"; family planning "discounts may be available based on income and family size."
cost_note: STI testing and treatment and home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines have fees with income-based discounts.

name: Wake County Southern Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
evidence: County STI services "are provided at no charge ... except for HPV treatment"; family planning "discounts may be available based on income and family size."
cost_note: STI testing and treatment and home test kits are free; other visits and vaccines have fees, with income-based discounts.

name: NC Services for the Blind – Medical Eye Care Program
evidence: DSB desk reference: "There is a $5 co-payment on the exam which is due to the eye care provider"; the state-funded program pays for approved care for income-eligible people.
cost_note: $5 co-pay on eye exams; the program pays for approved surgery, treatment and medicine for those who qualify.

name: SPCA Wake – Microchip & Vaccine Wellness Clinics
evidence: Microchip $5.00, rabies 1-year $10.00, FVRCP/DAPP $5.00, collar and tag $5.00; "All fees are donations to SPCA Wake and are non-refundable."
cost_note: Microchips and distemper vaccines $5, rabies shots $10, collar with ID tag $5.

name: Friends of Wake County Animal Center – Kitty Clip & Pit Stop Spay/Neuter Vouchers
evidence: "The voucher fee is $15, paid directly to the clinic at drop-off"; Pit Stop voucher is $40. For Wake residents unable to afford surgery.
cost_note: $15 for cats, $40 for pit bulls; covers exam, surgery and rabies/distemper shots.

name: APS of Durham – Spay & Neuter Community Assistance Program
evidence: Page offers "Reduced cost spay and neuter vouchers" for Durham County residents but lists no price.

name: Orange County Animal Services – Low-Cost Vaccine & Microchip Clinic (Chapel Hill)
evidence: Rabies "$10 for 1-year or 3-year"; "Microchips ... for $35 each"; DA2PPV/FVRCP vaccines free at the Chapel Hill clinics.
cost_note: Distemper vaccines are free; rabies shots $10; microchips $35.

name: CARE (Chatham Animal Rescue & Education) – Lillie's Fund Spay/Neuter
evidence: "$20 co-pay per pet" for Chatham County households with income "$50,000 or less"; covers surgery, vaccines, pain meds, optional microchip.
cost_note: $20 co-pay per pet covers surgery, vaccines, pain medicine and an optional microchip.

name: Raleigh Parks Community Garden Program
evidence: Program page and search show no plot fees; contact CommunityGardens@raleighnc.gov.

name: GoRaleigh buses – free & half-fare programs
evidence: Seniors 65+, youth 13–18, kids 12 and under, and TAP adults (Medicaid/SNAP or income under $35,000) ride free; full fare $1.25, reduced $0.60.
cost_note: Free for seniors, youth, kids and income-qualified adults (TAP card); others pay $1.25 a ride or $0.60 reduced.

name: GoRaleigh Access (ADA paratransit)
evidence: "the cost for an eligible ADA trip is $2.50 one way"; riders on Medicaid or SNAP/EBT or with income below $35,000 "can ride GoRaleigh Access for free."
cost_note: Free with a Transit Assistance Pass (Medicaid, SNAP or income under $35,000); otherwise $2.50 each way.

name: GoWake Access (Wake County van rides)
evidence: Medicaid transportation: no fare for Medicaid-approved appointments; all other categories cost "$2 same city, $4 different town or city."
cost_note: Medicaid medical rides are free; other trips cost $2 within a town or $4 between towns.

name: Go Wake Forest microtransit & Reduced Fare Program
evidence: Fares $2.50–$4.50 by distance; reduced fare "discounted fare rates of 50 percent"; "Children 12 and under ride at no cost."
cost_note: Kids 12 and under ride free; reduced fare is half price ($1.25–$2.25) for seniors, people with disabilities and income-qualified riders.

name: Lincoln Community Health Center – patient transportation
evidence: Rides are for registered patients "unable to afford public transportation"; the page doesn't state whether rides cost anything.

name: Orange County DSS – Medicaid transportation
evidence: NC Medicaid: "Free rides to and from your Medicaid medical and mental health appointments"; Medicaid Direct members arrange rides through county DSS.

name: Chapel Hill Transit EZ Rider (ADA paratransit)
evidence: Chapel Hill Transit fee schedule: "Certified EZ Rider Customers" – "Fare Free."

name: Wheels 4 Hope (low-cost cars through partner agencies)
evidence: Recipients pay "$500 for the car, NC DMV title transfer fees, and taxes."
cost_note: Cars cost $500 plus DMV title fees and taxes.

name: Self-Help
evidence: Self-Help says members "can connect with a Self-Help financial coach"; coaching via GreenPath is free; loans and credit-building products carry interest/fees. Own site blocked fetch.
cost_note: Financial coaching is free for members; loans and credit-builder products charge interest.

name: Entry Point Durham
evidence: City page blocked automated fetch; sources describe intake and referral at 414 E. Main St. / 984-287-8313 but none state cost.

name: Housing for New Hope -Rapid Rehousing
evidence: Homepage lists Affordable Housing and Supportive Housing programs but no Rapid Rehousing program and nothing on participant rent share or costs.

name: Freedom House Recovery Center
evidence: Residential services FAQ: "Medicaid and state funding cover our residential program" (11-bed men's house, two 6-bed women's houses in Durham).

name: Troy House
evidence: Site lists no fee; news reports say the re-entry council "will often provide funds to support residents, but they can also pay for it themselves."

name: LIFE House of Durham
evidence: "Residents are qualified through the Durham Housing Authority's Project Based Section 8 Program" – rent is set by tenant income.
cost_note: Rent is based on income through project-based Section 8.

name: Volunteers of America and of the Carolinas, Maple Court Veterans Transitional Housing Program
evidence: No resident rent or program fee found; listed URL is VOA's homepage and the Maple Court location page returns 404.

name: ACLU -NC
evidence: Free public know-your-rights web page for immigrants with downloadable guides; no fees mentioned. "This information is not intended as legal advice."

name: CWS Immigration Legal Services Center, Durham
evidence: CWS offers "high-quality legal services at no or low cost"; the page has an online payment option for legal services but lists no amounts.
cost_note: Legal services are free or low cost; call 919-680-3585 for fees.

name: North Carolina Justice Center, Raleigh
evidence: Justice Center "provides free legal advice and representation to hundreds of low-income immigrants each year"; intake page says it is not accepting new cases currently.

name: Durham Tech
evidence: "Please note: All ESL courses are free." Course listings show a cost of $0.

name: Asylum Seekers Advocacy Project
evidence: "ASAP membership is completely free and voluntary"; no fee to apply or maintain membership.

name: InStepp Inc
evidence: Immigration page offers "Low-Cost Immigration Legal Services" and "Low-Cost Naturalization Services"; no fee amounts listed.
cost_note: Low-cost fees for immigration and naturalization help; call 919-680-8000 for prices.

name: Apex Immigration Services
evidence: "Its legal fees are therefor set at low, affordable rates and include a sliding scale based on ability to pay."
cost_note: Low legal fees on a sliding scale based on ability to pay.

name: Alliance Medical Ministry
evidence: "The membership program is based on household size and income." Fees "range from $40-$160 per year"; counseling at "no additional charge."
cost_note: Annual membership of $40–$160 based on household size and income.

name: El Vinculo Hispano
evidence: EVH site lists offices in Siler City and Sanford only (no Chapel Hill); no service fees stated, only its Fiesta is marked "GRATIS."

name: Haven House Outreach Center
